description.value: The Kelowna Beer Institute is a craft brewery and taproom in the heart of Kelowna's Cultural District, where all beers are brewed on-site in small batches by brewmaster Dave Gokiert and served unfiltered tank-to-tap. The kitchen produces wings, nachos, house-made pizzas, and sandwiches crafted to pair with each beer, with all items available to eat in or take away. The space is designed as an open community hub where guests can learn about craft beer directly from the people who brew it.
